summary: Aristides Distilling is a craft distillery in Tseri, Nicosia, Cyprus, trading name of Crim Dell Ltd. It makes Terra Rossa Vodka from locally grown Cypriot potatoes, alongside zivania, gin and whisky. It was co-founded by Aris Aristidou and Marianna Aristidou and began operations on 1 January 2020.
ownership: Trade name registered by Crim Dell Ltd; co-founded by Aris Aristidou and Marianna Aristidou
products: Terra Rossa Vodka: potato vodka made from Cyprus potatoes, 40% ABV, 70cl and 10cl
Gin Series: Aoratos, Angelica, Berry and Flower Power
